Title: Data Engineer
Must have: Spark, SQL
Nice to have: Kafka, Airflow, Snowflake, dbt
Minimum experience: 3 years

About the role:
Design and run the data pipelines that feed our analytics and reporting. You will process large event streams, schedule batch jobs and model warehouse tables for analysts.
